name: Alternative.me

sources.title: Alternative.me - sign up page (linked from the how-to)

requirements: Submission of new software is open to everyone, but a user account is required
Product should be software/app-like so alternatives can be attached to it
preparation: Product name, website URL, and a clear description of what the software does
Logo/icon and screenshots if the submission form offers uploads
Knowledge of which existing alternative.me entries your product is an alternative to (helps categorization)
workflow: Register at https://alternative.me/signup/ with an email address
Log in and open the account dashboard
Click 'submit new software' and complete the entry form
Manage or edit the submission later from the same dashboard
watchFor: The how-to documents only the account + dashboard flow; the exact field list inside the submit form was not publicly visible without an account
Separate 'Suggest Alternatives' flow exists for linking your product as an alternative to existing entries - don't confuse it with the new-software submission
No paid submission route is advertised on the how-to page
countsAsLive: The software has its own public entry page on alternative.me and appears in software/alternatives browsing
unknowns: Whether submissions are reviewed before going live, and the review SLA
Exact required fields inside the authenticated submit form
Whether the outbound product link is dofollow
